title: Harold N NDE 5107
content: I was aware that I had flat lined - yet again! It was just another in a long series of cardiac flat lines after a septal ablation. But this one was different! Instead of 'waking up' a night later, like all of the others, I suddenly became aware that I was flying like superman. It was sudden, like I was an orange pip squeezed out from between someone's fingers. It was sunny and warm and the warm breeze in my face felt wonderful. I looked around. What the heck was happening? I saw I was 'flying' over a bay, which was a deep blue and had lovely sandy beaches. Just out from the bay was what appeared to be a volcanic tropical island. The sun was high in the sky. Sitting at anchor in the bay was an unusual large sailing ship with one huge sail but with multiple decks - at least three. There were tiny people crowding the uppermost deck of the sailing ship and beckoning to me. They were laughing, gesturing, waving, and calling on me to join them. I felt so good and was flying straight to the ship. Then just as I was getting close it all faded and I was back in my bed with medical staff around me and my wife grasping my hand in a crushing grip.
